diagnosis: The dashboard preview card generator looks up dashboards strictly by slug and renders an internal loopback URL using elevated system render tokens. It fails to check if the dashboard is marked isPublic or if req.user._id matches dashboard.ownerId. An attacker can query private dashboards belonging to other accounts and receive rendered JPEG images of proprietary charts and metrics.

GET /api/dashboards/q3-confidential-m-and-a-metrics/preview-card HTTP/1.1

Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni...
Accept: image/jpeg
